verdict.rationale: Honcho documents self-hosting: the open-source core can run on your own infrastructure [honcho-docs-9], `honcho start` brings up the API, deriver, Postgres and Redis locally via Docker [honcho-docs-10], and the MCP server can run locally instead of mcp.honcho.dev [honcho-docs-16]. However, its background reasoning depends on an LLM, and the only model evidence lists OpenAI, Anthropic and a vague 'custom' option [honcho-docs-6], so a fully cloud-free setup with local models is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: an embedded in-process mode, explicit local-model (e.g., Ollama/vLLM) support for the deriver and chat, and hands-on confirmation that it runs fully offline.
